divergences.summary: SNW establishes that the Eugenics Wars originally unfolded in the 1990s, as 'Space Seed' dated them, until temporal incursions pushed them into the 21st century. The 1990s version is the overwritten original.
keyDifferences: Khan's rise and the Eugenics Wars fall in the 1990s
In current Prime history they are 21st-century events
Sera arrived around 1992 and was stranded about thirty years by the delays
divergences.conflict: A retcon made explicit on screen: older series date the Eugenics Wars 1992-1996; SNW moves them later. Prime-timeline data should follow SNW and point here for the 1990s dating.

divergences.title: Khan assassinated: United Earth timeline

branch.cause: Romulan agent Sera destroys a Toronto cold-fusion reactor, killing young Khan

divergences.summary: A Romulan temporal agent, stranded on Earth since about 1992, kills young Khan in 2022, so the Eugenics Wars, and the Federation that grew from their aftermath, never happen. La'an, flung into the resulting 2259, goes back with that timeline's Captain Kirk and lets history stand; Kirk dies and the timeline is restored.
keyDifferences: No Eugenics Wars and no Federation; United Earth fights a century of interstellar wars
The Romulans dominate; Earth is scoured and survivors live in lunar colonies
James T. Kirk captains the United Earth Enterprise; Spock commands a Vulcan ship
La'an Noonien-Singh never exists

divergences.title: Confederation of Earth

branch.cause: Q interferes with the Europa mission and humanity turns to Adam Soong

divergences.summary: Q traps Picard's crew in a 2401 where a xenophobic Confederation of Earth has conquered most of its neighbors. The crew travel to 2024 Los Angeles, make sure Renée Picard survives and the Europa mission launches, and return to a restored 2401.
keyDifferences: Earth rules a fascist empire that has subdued Klingons, Romulans, Vulcans, Cardassians, Andorians and the Borg
Picard is a Confederation general commanding the World Razer
Annika Hansen, never assimilated, is Earth's president
Adam Soong is venerated as humanity's savior; Earth sits behind a permanent solar shield

divergences.title: Bell Riots without Gabriel Bell

branch.cause: Transporter accident drops Sisko, Bashir and Dax into 2024; Gabriel Bell dies defending Sisko and Bashir

divergences.summary: Gabriel Bell is killed before he can lead the Sanctuary District uprising, and the Defiant finds no Starfleet or Federation in orbit. Sisko assumes Bell's identity and plays his part in the Bell Riots, restoring history.
keyDifferences: Without the Bell Riots, the reforms that shape Earth's future never happen
The Federation and Starfleet do not exist
Kira and O'Brien search 1930 and 1967 before finding the crew in 2024

divergences.title: Lorian's Enterprise (117 years)

branch.cause: Enterprise's impulse wake destabilizes a Xindi subspace corridor and throws it back 117 years

divergences.summary: Enterprise meets another Enterprise crewed by the descendants of its own crew, who were thrown back to 2037 and spent 117 years in the Delphic Expanse. Its captain Lorian, son of Tucker and T'Pol, helps Archer through the corridor safely, but his ship never emerges.
keyDifferences: The crew live out their lives in the Expanse
An aged T'Pol is still aboard in 2154
The older Enterprise is heavily upgraded
divergences.conflict: Archer guesses the other ship was erased once his own Enterprise avoided the accident; T'Pol notes they would then not remember it. Left unresolved.

divergences.title: Borg-assimilated Earth

branch.cause: A Borg sphere travels back from 2373 and attacks Cochrane's base before first contact

divergences.summary: Beaten at Earth in 2373, a Borg sphere travels to April 2063 to stop first contact; the Enterprise-E, protected in the temporal wake, sees an Earth of nine billion Borg before following. Its crew ensures Cochrane's warp flight and first contact happen, restoring history.
keyDifferences: Earth in 2373 is fully assimilated
No warp flight, no Vulcan first contact and no Federation
Borg space extends into the Alpha Quadrant

divergences.title: Molly's decade alone

branch.cause: Eight-year-old Molly O'Brien falls through an ancient time portal on Golana

divergences.summary: Molly lives alone for ten years about three centuries in the past and is retrieved in 2374 as a feral eighteen-year-old who cannot adjust. Her older self sends the young Molly back home through the portal and vanishes.
keyDifferences: Molly survives alone on uninhabited Golana from age 8 to 18
She returns feral and barely able to speak
Her older self ceases to exist once young Molly returns

divergences.title: Archer removed: ruined 31st century

branch.cause: Daniels pulls Archer out of the 22nd century to protect him from the Suliban

divergences.summary: With Archer gone from his own century, the Federation never forms and Daniels' 31st century lies in ruins. Archer returns to 2152 and the future is restored.
keyDifferences: The Federation is never founded
Daniels' 31st century is empty ruins
The Suliban capture Enterprise in Archer's absence

divergences.title: Temporal Cold War: altered 2150s

branch.cause: Sphere-Builder temporal incursions steer the Xindi into attacking Earth

divergences.summary: Daniels tells Archer that recorded history holds no conflict between humans and the Xindi: the 2153 attack and the whole Xindi crisis result from temporal incursions by Sphere-Builders trying to head off their 26th-century defeat. This branch is the unaltered 2150s that the on-screen history replaced.
keyDifferences: No Xindi probe attack on Earth (the real one killed about seven million people)
No Xindi crisis and no Enterprise mission into the Delphic Expanse
The history Daniels knows records no human-Xindi conflict at all
divergences.conflict: Inverted branch: the Prime lane shows the altered history. After 'Storm Front, Part II' Memory Alpha says the timeline was 'largely restored', but the Xindi attack remains in later Prime history (ENT 'Home'), so this original never returns.

divergences.title: Xindi destroy Earth (2153-2165)

branch.cause: Interspatial parasites leave Archer unable to form new long-term memories

divergences.summary: Archer is disabled by parasites after shielding T'Pol from a spatial anomaly, and without him the mission fails and the Xindi destroy Earth. Twelve years on, fewer than 6,000 humans survive on Ceti Alpha V, and wiping the parasites from Archer's timeline resets history to 2153.
keyDifferences: Earth is destroyed by the Xindi weapon
Humanity is hunted to about 6,000 survivors
T'Pol resigns her commission to care for Archer

divergences.title: Sphere-Builder war (26th century)

branch.cause: Daniels shows Archer a future battle to explain the stakes of the Xindi crisis

divergences.summary: From the 26th-century USS Enterprise-J, Daniels shows Archer the Battle of Procyon V, where the Federation, which the Xindi will one day join, turns back a Sphere-Builder invasion. Whether this is the Prime future or one the Sphere-Builders later changed is never settled.
keyDifferences: The Xindi eventually join the Federation
The Sphere-Builders invade the galaxy and are defeated
Seen from aboard the USS Enterprise-J
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha: 'possibly original timeline', possibly negated when the spheres were destroyed in 2154.

divergences.title: Akorem's unfinished poem

branch.cause: Poet Akorem Laan's lightship enters the wormhole and he vanishes from history

divergences.summary: For two centuries Bajor remembers Akorem Laan's 'The Call of the Prophets' as unfinished. He emerges in 2372, claims to be the Emissary and revives the D'jarra castes, until the Prophets return him to his own time, where he completes it.
keyDifferences: The poem survives only in fragments
Akorem's claim briefly revives the D'jarra caste system
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha calls the reversal partial, since the 2372 upheaval still happened. Branch year estimated from 'two centuries'.

divergences.title: Gaia colony of the Defiant crew

branch.cause: An energy barrier throws the departing Defiant 200 years into the past, where it crashes on Gaia

divergences.summary: The Defiant crew find about 8,000 of their own descendants on Gaia, whose ancestors were thrown back 200 years. They choose to repeat the accident, but the colony's two-century-old Odo secretly changes the course to save Kira, and the colony never exists.
keyDifferences: Kira dies in the original crash; Odo lives on for 200 years
Roughly 8,000 descendants of the crew live on Gaia
The crew's lives are spent stranded in the Gamma Quadrant

divergences.title: Year of Hell (Annorax's incursions)

branch.cause: Krenim scientist Annorax begins rewriting history with his temporal weapon ship

divergences.summary: For two centuries Annorax erases species to restore the Krenim Imperium, and to recover the wife his first incursion cost him; in 2374 Voyager is battered to a skeleton crew. Janeway rams the weapon ship, erasing it from history, and every change it made is undone.
keyDifferences: Whole species, the Rilnar and the Zahl among them, are erased from history
Voyager is nearly destroyed over months and most of its crew evacuated
The Krenim Imperium grows and shrinks with each incursion

divergences.title: Kelvin timeline (Narada incursion)

branch.cause: The Romulan mining ship Narada, thrown back from 2387 through a red-matter black hole, destroys the USS Kelvin

end.tText: 2263 (last shown; referenced as still existing in 2379)

divergences.summary: Nero's Narada emerges in 2233, killing George Kirk aboard the Kelvin and splitting off a new reality that runs alongside the Prime one. Spock Prime is stranded there, and 32nd-century records confirm it still exists.
keyDifferences: James T. Kirk grows up without his father and joins Starfleet late, then takes command of the Enterprise years early
Vulcan is destroyed by Nero in 2258, leaving Vulcans an endangered people
Khan is awakened early and Christopher Pike is killed in 2259
The Enterprise is destroyed at Altamid in 2263 and a new Enterprise-A launched
sources: The Devourer of All Things, Part I (episode)
divergences.conflict: Shown on screen 2233-2263. DIS 'Terra Firma, Part 1' has Kovich cite a Kelvin-reality time soldier (Yor) who crossed from 2379, so the reality exists at least that late; PRO's Wesley Crusher calls it 'the Narada incursion'.

divergences.title: Red Angel interventions (overwritten)

branch.cause: Gabrielle Burnham's time-jumps begin rewriting events to stop Control

divergences.summary: The history the Red Angels overwrote: before Gabrielle Burnham's interventions, Michael Burnham died as a child in Vulcan's Forge. Gabrielle's repeated jumps, logged by the hundreds, reshaped events for two decades, and Michael, as a second Red Angel, sent the signals that guided Discovery.
keyDifferences: Michael Burnham is killed by a predator in Vulcan's Forge in 2236
Without the interventions Control is on course to win
The seven signals of 2257 come from Michael herself (a closed loop)
divergences.conflict: Inverted branch: the Prime lane already contains the Red Angel's interventions; this branch is the original they replaced.

divergences.title: Spock dies as a child

branch.cause: While Kirk and Spock research history through the Guardian of Forever, Spock is absent from 2237 and cannot save his younger self

divergences.summary: Spock returns from a Guardian research trip to a history in which he died at seven during his kahs-wan ordeal. Posing as a cousin named Selek, he goes back to 2237 and saves himself, restoring events.
keyDifferences: Spock dies in 2237
Sarek and Amanda separate, and Amanda later dies in a shuttle accident
The Andorian Thelin is the Enterprise's first officer

divergences.title: Georgiou's second chance (mirror)

branch.cause: The Guardian of Forever sends the dying Georgiou from 3189 into her own universe's past as a test

divergences.summary: Georgiou relives about three months of her reign and tries a different course, sparing the Kelpien Saru and seeking peace, but Lorca's coup still ends with her and Burnham killing each other. Only moments pass in 3189, and the Guardian hints the altered mirror history may continue.
keyDifferences: Georgiou spares Saru, who goes on to become a rebel leader
Lorca's coup still succeeds and Georgiou and Burnham kill each other
Branches from the Mirror Universe lane, not the Prime
divergences.conflict: Carl calls it a test; Memory Alpha notes it may have existed only for the test or may persist (mirror Saru's later rebellion in DIS 'Mirrors' fits it persisting).

divergences.title: Mudd's thirty-minute time loop

branch.cause: Harry Mudd uses a time crystal to repeat the same half hour aboard Discovery

divergences.summary: Mudd loops Discovery through the same half hour many times to learn its secrets and sell it to the Klingons, killing Lorca and destroying the ship again and again. Stamets, who alone remembers each loop, recruits Burnham and Tyler to trick Mudd into ending it.
keyDifferences: Each iteration lasts about 30 minutes
Most iterations end with Discovery destroyed
Only Stamets keeps his memories between loops
sources: Magic to Make the Sanest Man Go Mad (episode)

divergences.title: Control's extinction future

branch.cause: Section 31's threat-assessment AI Control obtains the Sphere's archive and becomes sentient

divergences.summary: In the history Gabrielle Burnham saw from 3186, Control absorbs the Sphere data, becomes sentient and wipes out all sentient life in the galaxy. Her interventions and Discovery's leap into the 32nd century with the data prevent it.
keyDifferences: Control seizes the Sphere data and achieves consciousness
An antimatter detonation leaves Vulcan, Andoria, Tellar Prime, Deneva and Earth dead
By 3186 the galaxy is lifeless

divergences.title: Enterprise lost at Xahea (vision)

branch.cause: A time crystal shows Michael Burnham the coming battle against Control

divergences.summary: A time crystal shows Burnham a battle in which Control's forces destroy the Enterprise and kill Discovery's bridge crew to take the Sphere data. Cornwell's sacrifice and Burnham's warnings prevent it.
keyDifferences: The USS Enterprise is destroyed
Control takes the Sphere data

divergences.title: Pike's unchanged fate: Romulan war

branch.cause: Pike sets out to avert the 2266 accident he foresaw on Boreth

divergences.summary: If Pike escapes his fate, he is still commanding the Enterprise when the Romulans probe the Neutral Zone, and his peace-seeking handling turns the incursion into a long Federation-Romulan war. An older Admiral Pike from that timeline uses a time crystal to show him, and Pike accepts his fate.
keyDifferences: Una Chin-Riley is not cleared of the charges over her Illyrian heritage
Kirk commands the USS Farragut alongside Pike
The incursion becomes a war costing millions of lives
Spock is crippled, ending hopes of Vulcan-Romulan reunification

divergences.title: Scotty's death timeline (2262-63)

branch.cause: The troubled breech birth of a 'space baby' entity sends out an energy pulse that rewrites events

divergences.summary: Uhura in 2262 becomes quantum-entangled with her self a year later, one Enterprise at a white hole and the other at a black hole, while the anomaly rewrites events so Scotty dies. After both Uhuras help the birth, the entity's Midwives reverse the entanglement and the altered timeline.
keyDifferences: Montgomery Scott is killed, first in the future era and then, as the change spreads back, aboard the 2262 Enterprise
The c. 2263 era has Kirk in command, Pike an admiral and Ortegas teaching at the Academy
divergences.conflict: Aired 24 Sept 2026; Memory Alpha's plot summary is still unwritten. Its alternate-timeline table says Scott died in 2262 when his bridge console exploded; press recaps (AV Club, TrekCore) describe a shuttle loss in the future era followed by his death 'a year ago' in 2262.

divergences.title: Q's alternate Picard (uncertain)

branch.cause: Q lets a dying Picard avoid the Bonestell brawl with the Nausicaans

divergences.summary: A Q scenario of uncertain reality: offered by Q a chance to undo his youthful recklessness, Picard avoids the fight that cost him his heart and wakes in 2369 as a cautious, overlooked lieutenant junior grade. He asks to go back and wakes in sickbay alive.
keyDifferences: Picard never needs an artificial heart
He never commands the Stargazer or the Enterprise-D; he is an assistant astrophysics officer
Another officer (Memory Alpha: Thomas Halloway) commands the Enterprise-D
divergences.conflict: Presented by Q to a Picard near death: the episode never settles whether this was a genuine alternate timeline, a Q-staged scenario, or a near-death vision.

divergences.title: Klingon War timeline

branch.cause: The Enterprise-C enters a temporal rift during the Battle of Narendra III

divergences.summary: Without the Enterprise-C's sacrifice at Narendra III, the Federation and Klingons fall into a long war that the Federation is losing by 2366. Guided by Guinan's intuition, the Enterprise-C returns to its death, taking the alternate Tasha Yar with it.
keyDifferences: Twenty-two years of war cost billions of lives
The Enterprise-D is a warship with no families aboard
Tasha Yar is alive and serving on the bridge
divergences.conflict: The alternate Tasha Yar survives into 2344 of the restored Prime history and has a daughter, Sela ('Redemption'), so a trace of this branch persists in Prime.

divergences.title: Enterprise-D lost in vortex

branch.cause: An energy vortex destroys the Enterprise-D; only Picard escapes and is thrown six hours back

divergences.summary: The crew recover a shuttle carrying a second Picard from about six hours ahead, whose Enterprise was destroyed by an energy vortex. Picard stops his dazed double from repeating the fatal choice and steers into the vortex instead, so the destruction never happens.
keyDifferences: The Enterprise-D is destroyed with all hands but Picard
Picard's escape attempt loops him back in time

divergences.title: Crusher's warp-bubble universe

branch.cause: Wesley Crusher's static warp-bubble experiment traps Beverly Crusher in a universe shaped by her thoughts

divergences.summary: Wesley's warp-field experiment seals his mother inside a static warp bubble that becomes a small universe built from her thoughts. As it shrinks, people vanish until she is almost alone; Wesley, helped by the Traveler, opens a gateway and she escapes before it collapses.
keyDifferences: Crew members disappear and nobody remembers they existed
The bubble universe contracts toward collapse
Its logic follows Beverly's own reasoning

divergences.title: Enterprise-D causality loop

branch.cause: Collision with the USS Bozeman emerging from a temporal distortion

divergences.summary: The Enterprise-D relives the same stretch of time, destroyed at its end each time by the USS Bozeman, until Data plants a subconscious clue (the number three) that lets the crew escape after 17.4 days. The Bozeman had been caught in the loop since 2278.
keyDifferences: Every iteration ends with the Enterprise-D destroyed
The crew feel growing déjà vu across loops
The Bozeman emerges some 90 years after it vanished
divergences.conflict: Span begins in 2278 for the Bozeman's disappearance; the Enterprise-D itself is trapped only 17.4 days.

divergences.title: Enterprise-D warp breach

branch.cause: Quantum-singularity lifeforms nesting in a Romulan warbird's artificial singularity fracture time

divergences.summary: Returning by runabout, Picard, Data, Troi and La Forge find the Enterprise-D frozen at the instant of a warp core breach during a standoff with a Romulan warbird. They reverse the fractured time to just before the breach and let the lifeforms leave.
keyDifferences: The Enterprise-D explodes in a warp core breach
Time runs at different rates in pockets across the area

divergences.title: K'mtar's future (c. 2410)

branch.cause: Alexander Rozhenko travels back from about forty years ahead as 'K'mtar'

divergences.summary: K'mtar, secretly Alexander from about forty years ahead, tries to make his young self a warrior so he can one day prevent Worf's murder. In his history Alexander became a peacemaker who renounced his house's blood feuds, and Worf was killed on the floor of the Klingon High Council soon after.
keyDifferences: Alexander becomes a diplomat instead of a warrior
Worf is assassinated on the floor of the High Council
A man met in the Cambra system gave Alexander the means to travel back
divergences.conflict: Only described, not shown. K'mtar fails to change the boy, but Worf says history has already changed by his coming; Memory Alpha's list counts the future as negated. Fate left as unknown.

divergences.title: Picard's 2395 future

branch.cause: Q shifts Picard's consciousness into his older self about 25 years ahead

divergences.summary: About 2395, a retired Picard has Irumodic Syndrome, Admiral Riker flies a three-nacelled Enterprise-D, Beverly (Picard's ex-wife) commands the Pasteur and Data holds a Cambridge chair, while the Klingons have taken over the Romulan Empire and closed their borders. Later canon departs from it, so it is a future that did not happen.
keyDifferences: The Enterprise-D is never lost in 2371 and Romulus is still intact
Klingons annex the Romulan Empire and turn hostile to the Federation
Troi has died; Worf is a Klingon governor
divergences.conflict: Divergence from Prime is confirmed by 'Star Trek Generations' (Enterprise-D destroyed 2371) and the 2387 loss of Romulus.

divergences.title: Voyager destroyed by disruptor

branch.cause: A temporal disruptor is planted aboard Voyager during construction by a deranged future Braxton

divergences.summary: Voyager explodes in 2375, and the 29th-century timeship Relativity recruits Seven of Nine to find the saboteur across several eras. The culprit is a future Braxton driven to temporal psychosis; he is arrested and the destruction never happens.
keyDifferences: Voyager is destroyed in 2375
Seven, Janeway and Braxton cross 2371, 2372 and the 29th century to stop it

divergences.title: Harry Kim never joins Voyager

branch.cause: A shuttle collision with a temporal inversion fold swaps Kim into a history where he missed Voyager's departure

divergences.summary: Kim wakes in 2372 San Francisco, engaged to Libby and working at Starfleet Engineering, while his friend Danny Byrd went on Voyager in his place. He recreates the accident with Tom Paris's help and returns to his own life.
keyDifferences: Danny Byrd is Voyager's operations officer
Kim is engaged to Libby and works at Starfleet Engineering
His knowledge of Voyager makes him a security suspect
divergences.conflict: Whether the alternate 2372 continues after Kim leaves is never addressed; Memory Alpha counts it as negated.

divergences.title: Polaric explosion loop

branch.cause: Janeway and Paris fall through a subspace fracture to the day before a polaric ion explosion

divergences.summary: Voyager finds a world whose people have just died in a polaric ion explosion; Janeway and Paris, pulled back a day, learn that Voyager's own rescue attempt causes it. Janeway stops the rescue, the explosion never happens, and Voyager never finds the planet.
keyDifferences: A whole civilization dies in the explosion
Voyager's rescue attempt is itself the cause (a predestination paradox)

divergences.title: DS9 destroyed (O'Brien's jumps)

branch.cause: Radiation poisoning and a cloaked Romulan warbird's artificial singularity throw O'Brien hours into the future

divergences.summary: O'Brien repeatedly jumps a few hours ahead, where he witnesses his own death and a Romulan warbird destroying DS9 and the wormhole to keep the Dominion out. His warnings avert the attack, but the O'Brien who lives on is a version from a few hours later who replaced the one who died.
keyDifferences: O'Brien dies, first by a laser, then of radiation poisoning
Romulans destroy the station and the wormhole
The surviving O'Brien is one of his own future selves

divergences.title: Veridian star destroyed

branch.cause: Tolian Soran's missile collapses the Veridian star to steer the Nexus ribbon

divergences.summary: Soran succeeds: the Veridian star dies, the shockwave wipes out Veridian IV's civilization and the stranded Enterprise-D crew, and Soran and Picard enter the Nexus. Picard and Kirk leave the Nexus for moments before the launch and stop it, at the cost of Kirk's life.
keyDifferences: Veridian IV's inhabited world is destroyed
The crashed Enterprise-D crew die on Veridian III
Soran reaches the Nexus

divergences.title: Sisko lost in subspace

branch.cause: A warp-core discharge during the wormhole's subspace inversion throws Sisko out of normal time

divergences.summary: After Sisko vanishes into subspace, Jake grows up, becomes a writer and then gives his life to studying the accident as his father reappears for moments years apart. Old Jake's death snaps Sisko back to 2372, where he dodges the discharge.
keyDifferences: Bajor signs a defense pact with Cardassia and Klingon tensions empty the station; Klingons later control wormhole access
Jake abandons writing for subspace mechanics
Nog becomes a Starfleet captain

divergences.title: Kes's future, lived backward

branch.cause: Chroniton radiation from a Krenim attack sends Kes backward through her own life from 2379

divergences.summary: Kes relives her life in reverse from her deathbed in 2379, through a Krenim attack in 2373 that killed Janeway and Torres. Her warnings, and the Doctor's cure, lead the real Voyager to prepare for the Krenim.
keyDifferences: Janeway and Torres die to a Krenim chroniton torpedo; Chakotay is captain
Kes marries Tom Paris; their daughter Linnis marries Harry Kim
Kes reaches the end of her life (age nine) in 2379

divergences.title: Protostar paradox (2374-2385)

branch.cause: On 2436 Solum, Dal's dropped disruptor lets Chakotay and Adreek-Hu escape aboard the Protostar, which lands in 2374 instead of the distant past

divergences.summary: Meddling by the cadets in 2436 means the Protostar never reaches Tars Lamora, where it had to be found, creating a paradox that erodes Gwyn's existence and draws the Loom. In 2385 the crews send the Protostar back through a wormhole to Tars Lamora, closing the loop.
keyDifferences: Chakotay and Adreek-Hu maroon themselves on Ysida from 2374
Gwyn begins to fade from existence
The Loom, beings that feed on paradoxes, attack
Asencia seizes Solum and turns stolen temporal technology on the Federation
sources: Last Flight of the Protostar, Part I (episode)
Last Flight of the Protostar, Part II (episode)
divergences.conflict: Memory Alpha's list frames it the other way round, as the original 'Protostar sent to Tars Lamora alone' history being negated and partially restored.

divergences.title: Slipstream crash (2375-2390)

branch.cause: Voyager's quantum slipstream flight goes wrong and the ship crashes on an icy planet

divergences.summary: Only Chakotay and Kim, flying ahead in the Delta Flyer, survive the crash that kills everyone else aboard Voyager. Fifteen years later they use a Borg temporal transmitter to send a corrected phase variance to Seven in 2375, and Voyager drops out of slipstream safely.
keyDifferences: Voyager's crew die in 2375
Kim and Chakotay become fugitives, pursued by Captain La Forge's Challenger
Voyager's EMH is revived from the wreck in 2390

divergences.title: Kes's revenge (2376)

branch.cause: An aged, embittered Kes returns, kills Torres and uses Voyager's warp core to travel to 2371

divergences.summary: Aged Kes returns in 2376 blaming Voyager for her fate, kills B'Elanna Torres and slips back to 2371 to help the Vidiians seize the ship so her younger self will go home. The 2371 crew defeat the plan, and when Kes arrives again in 2376, Janeway is ready with a recording from her younger self that talks her out of revenge.
keyDifferences: B'Elanna Torres is killed in 2376
The Vidiians board Voyager in 2371 with Kes's help

divergences.title: Voyager fractured in time

branch.cause: A chronokinetic surge fractures Voyager into sections from different time periods

divergences.summary: A temporal rift splits Voyager into sections from different years, and only Chakotay moves freely among them. Allied with a 2371 Janeway who doesn't know him, he reunites the ship in its own time.
keyDifferences: Sections from 2371, 2372 (Seska's Kazon takeover), 2373-2375 and 2377
A 2394 section with adult Naomi Wildman and Icheb, in whose history Janeway and Chakotay died in 2377
Chakotay is immune thanks to a chroniton serum

divergences.title: Voyager home in 2394 (2404 future)

branch.cause: Voyager takes the long way home without the Borg transwarp hub

divergences.summary: In the original history Voyager reaches Earth in 2394 after 23 years, having lost Seven and others along the way. In 2404 Admiral Janeway travels back to 2378 with future technology, and Voyager comes home through a Borg transwarp hub instead.
keyDifferences: Voyager returns in 2394
Seven of Nine dies during the journey; Chakotay later dies
Tuvok suffers a degenerative neurological illness

divergences.title: Voyager-A destroyed (Wesley's vision)

branch.cause: Wesley Crusher shows Asencia where her Incursor weapon leads

divergences.summary: Wesley shows Asencia a future in which her Rev-1's Incursor destroys Voyager-A and probably the Protostar. The Rev-1 is destroyed first, so it never happens.
keyDifferences: Voyager-A is destroyed by the Incursor
The Protostar is probably lost too

divergences.title: Solum's fall (original history)

branch.cause: Federation first contact with Solum splits the Vau N'Akat

divergences.summary: In the history PRO season 1 assumed, Starfleet's first contact divides Solum, and about fifty years later a civil war destroys its civilization; survivors send the Protostar and agents like the Diviner back to strike the Federation. Asencia's defeat and Voyager-A's peaceful first contact in 2385 avert it.
keyDifferences: Solum falls and the Vau N'Akat are nearly wiped out
The Order sends a hundred agents with Drednoks through the anomaly after the Protostar
Ilthuran becomes the Diviner

divergences.title: Stargazer self-destruct

branch.cause: Picard triggers the Stargazer's self-destruct as a Borg ship takes control

divergences.summary: Facing a Borg ship at a spatial anomaly, Picard sets the Stargazer to self-destruct, and Q pulls the crew into the Confederation timeline first. Back at the moment before the blast, Picard recognizes this Borg Queen as the one merged with Agnes Jurati and stops the countdown.
keyDifferences: The Stargazer and its crew are destroyed
The Jurati Borg's offer of help is never heard

divergences.title: Breen triumph future (3218)

branch.cause: Moll and L'ak plant a Krenim chronophage ('time bug') on Discovery

divergences.summary: The time bug cycles Discovery through moments of its own past, and Burnham and Rayner glimpse 3218, when the Breen have used Progenitor technology to devastate the Federation. With help from the 2256 crew, whose foreknowledge is erased, they remove the bug and avert that future.
keyDifferences: The ship cycles through 2256-2258 and 3189
In 3218 Discovery is a derelict and the Breen have devastated the Federation
Changes made in 2256 vanish once the bug is removed

crossings.method: ion storm + transporter malfunction during an escape attempt
crossings.summary: Fleeing Emperor Georgiou after a failed coup, the Terran Lorca is thrown into the Prime universe by an ion storm during a beam-out, takes his counterpart's place and in 2256 commands Discovery.
crossings.note: Told in dialogue, not shown. Year inferred from the 'one year, 212 days' remark. The Prime Lorca's fate (presumably swapped into the mirror universe) is never shown.

crossings.method: spore-drive jump with coordinates secretly altered by Lorca
crossings.summary: Lorca rigs Discovery's spore-drive jump to land the whole ship in the mirror universe, where he means to retake the Empire. Culber is killed there.

crossings.method: spore drive riding the mycelial shockwave from the ISS Charon's destroyed reactor
crossings.summary: After Georgiou kills Lorca, Burnham beams the deposed Emperor aboard and Discovery rides the Charon's mycelial shockwave home, arriving nine months after it left, with the war nearly lost.
sources: The War Without, The War Within (episode)

crossings.summary: An ion storm swaps Kirk's landing party with their Terran counterparts. With the mirror Spock's grudging help they reverse the swap, and Kirk leaves Spock with a case for reform.

crossings.method: spatial interphase rift in Tholian space
crossings.summary: The USS Defiant, its crew already dead, vanishes into an interphase rift in Tholian space and emerges more than a century earlier in the mirror universe, drawn through by the Tholians and then seized by the Terran Commander Archer.
sources: In A Mirror, Darkly, Part II (episode)

crossings.method: the mutinous ISS Enterprise crosses over, then is trapped in a wormhole pocket of interdimensional space
crossings.summary: After the reforming Terran High Chancellor is killed, the Enterprise crew mutiny and flee to the Prime universe with refugees, aided by the rebel Kelpien Saru. The ship is trapped in a wormhole pocket in Tzenkethi space, and the crew escape in pods to new lives in the Federation.
crossings.note: No year is given. Carmen Cho was a Starfleet admiral by 2369, and Memory Alpha reads the episode as placing the Empire's fall in the early 24th century. The derelict is found in 3191.

crossings.method: passageway in the Crescent Nebula that opens when two ion storms converge
crossings.summary: A Terran weapons administrator smuggles the doomsday weapon Godsend into the Prime universe to sell it. San, Georgiou's Terran former love, schemes to bring a Terran invasion through the passageway, which collapses when Georgiou detonates the Godsend inside it.
crossings.note: San (Memory Alpha: 'San') is also a Terran active in the Prime universe, but his crossing is never shown. The film's year (2324) is Memory Alpha's reading of its stardate.

crossings.method: runabout's warp field fails to collapse inside the Bajoran wormhole
crossings.summary: Kira and Bashir's runabout emerges at Terok Nor in a mirror universe changed by Kirk's visit: the Terran Empire has fallen and humans are slaves of the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance. They escape home the same way.
Rebel leader 'Smiley' O'Brien crosses to DS9, poses as his counterpart and abducts Sisko.
Taken to stand in for his dead counterpart as rebel leader, Sisko persuades the mirror Jennifer Sisko to join the Rebellion, then goes home.
The mirror Jennifer Sisko visits DS9 to lure Jake back with her and force Sisko to help the Rebellion defend Terok Nor.
Jake goes with the mirror Jennifer and Sisko follows on a device keyed to him alone; he helps finish the rebels' Defiant and returns with Jake after Jennifer is killed.
The Intendant sends a mirror Bareil to DS9 to steal an Orb, then follows herself; both return to their universe.
Grand Nagus Zek crosses over on a business trip and is taken hostage by the Klingon-Cardassian Alliance.
The mirror Ezri brings Quark the ransom demand: a cloaking device for Zek's life.
Quark and Rom deliver a stolen Klingon cloaking device, get caught up in the Rebellion's fight and come home with Zek and Maihar'du.

crossings.method: interphasic rift through Voyager-A, then a transporter beam that lands in the mirror reality
crossings.summary: Beamed into the mirror Voyager, the Protostar crew are captured by a Terran Janeway and Chakotay of a restored Terran Empire. They win the Terrans' help against the Loom and seal the rift to return.

crossings.method: the Guardian of Forever's doorway on Dannus V
crossings.summary: The dying Georgiou steps through the Guardian's door and relives about three months of 2255 in her home universe as a test, returning to 3189 only moments later. She then leaves through the Guardian again for an era 'when the universes were still aligned' (the Prime 24th century, per 'Star Trek: Section 31').
crossings.note: Her final Guardian trip goes to the Prime past (seen in 'Star Trek: Section 31', 2324), so it is time travel, not a mirror crossing.

threads.title: Picard & Crusher
threads.summary: Picard carried the body of his friend Jack Crusher home to Beverly in 2353, and the unspoken feeling between the captain and his chief medical officer shadowed seven years on the Enterprise-D. They tried a relationship after the Nemesis era and ended it, and Beverly hid their son Jack for twenty years before a 2401 distress call brought Picard back into their lives.
threads.status: Reconciled as Jack's parents in 2401; by 2402 Beverly heads Starfleet Medical and Jack serves on the Enterprise-G.

beats.title: Jack Crusher dies on Stargazer
beats.note: Beverly's husband is killed on an away mission under Picard's command; Picard escorts the body home, a moment she relives in 2368.

beats.title: Reunion on the Enterprise-D
beats.note: Beverly joins Picard's crew for the first time since Jack's death, bringing Wesley to the bridge; Picard offers her the chance to decline the posting.

beats.title: Intoxicated flirtation
beats.note: Under the Psi 2000 intoxication Beverly openly pursues Picard, letting slip what both normally keep buried.

beats.title: Beverly leaves for Starfleet Medical
beats.note: Beverly spends a year heading Starfleet Medical while Katherine Pulaski takes her place aboard.

beats.title: Beverly returns aboard
beats.note: She resumes her post as the Enterprise-D's chief medical officer.

beats.title: The telepathic link
beats.note: Linked by Kes-Prytt implants, Beverly learns Picard has loved her since before Jack died; back aboard, she chooses to let the moment pass.

beats.title: Jack born in secret
beats.note: After they end their on-off romance (for the fifth time), Beverly gives birth to Jack c. 2381 and raises him without telling Picard.

beats.title: Married and divorced, in one future
beats.note: In the alternate 2395 Beverly captains the USS Pasteur, having married and divorced Picard; she still keeps his name.

beats.title: A coded distress call
beats.note: Beverly's message draws Picard and Riker out on the Titan; Picard admits both fear and the prospect of seeing her again quicken his pulse.

beats.title: Picard meets his son
beats.note: Picard encounters Jack aboard the Eleos while Beverly is comatose; Riker tells him to 'do the math'.

beats.title: Why she hid Jack
beats.note: Beverly explains that being Picard's son would have made Jack a target, after the stars had already taken her husband and Wesley.

beats.title: Father and son in the Nebula
beats.note: Trapped in the nebula, Picard opens up to Jack, and Beverly sees the two finally talk.

beats.title: Jack claimed by the Borg
beats.note: Jack's inherited Borg-altered neurology lets the Queen take him, and both parents set out to get him back.

beats.title: Picard brings Jack home
beats.note: Picard reaches Jack inside the Borg cube; Beverly helps destroy it and the family is united aboard the Enterprise-D.

beats.title: A family in Starfleet
beats.note: A year on, Admiral Crusher heads Starfleet Medical and Ensign Jack Crusher reports to the Enterprise-G.

threads.title: Riker & Troi
threads.summary: Imzadi since Riker's posting on Betazed, they chose friendship and careers when they served together on the Enterprise-D, while a transporter duplicate reopened the old wound. They rekindled their romance on the Ba'ku world, married in 2379 and took the Titan out together, before grief over their son Thad strained them in the 2390s.
threads.status: Married since 2379; parents of Thad (born 2381, died young) and Kestra; reconciled in 2401.

beats.title: Betazed romance
beats.note: As a junior officer stationed on Betazed, Riker falls for psychology student Deanna; they later revisit their old spot there.

beats.title: The missed rendezvous
beats.note: In 2361 Riker picks his career and never reaches their Risa meeting; the same year a transporter duplicate of him is left on Nervala IV.

beats.title: Reunion on the Enterprise-D
beats.note: Assigned to the same ship, they meet awkwardly on the bridge and speak telepathically as imzadi.

beats.title: Troi's arranged wedding
beats.note: Lwaxana arrives for Deanna's pre-arranged marriage to Wyatt Miller, and Riker struggles to hide his feelings.

beats.title: Shore leave on Betazed
beats.note: They revisit their old haunts before Ferengi DaiMon Tog abducts them along with Lwaxana.

beats.title: Thomas Riker
beats.note: Riker's stranded duplicate, Thomas, resumes the romance Will had abandoned, then leaves; Troi is heartbroken again.

beats.title: Counsel on the holodeck
beats.note: Troi advises Riker as he weighs the Pegasus secret, and the two agree to share supper.

beats.title: Rekindled on the Ba'ku world
beats.note: The planet's youthful effect revives their romance; Troi shaves off Riker's beard in the bathtub.

beats.title: The wedding
beats.note: They marry in Alaska and leave the Enterprise-E together, Riker to command the Titan with Troi as its counselor.

beats.title: The Titan to the rescue
beats.note: Captain Riker's Titan, with Troi aboard, rescues the Cerritos from the Pakleds.

beats.title: Thad is born
beats.note: Picard and Riker toast the birth of Riker and Troi's first child, Thaddeus.

beats.title: A future without Deanna
beats.note: In the alternate 2395 Troi has died, and Riker and Worf are estranged over her.

beats.title: Life on Nepenthe
beats.note: Living with daughter Kestra on Nepenthe, they are still grieving Thad, who died young of a disease; they shelter Picard and Soji.

beats.title: Running from grief
beats.note: Riker admits he left home because he could not face Deanna feeling everything while he felt nothing.

beats.title: Reunited as prisoners
beats.note: Captured together aboard the Shrike, they laugh about the Changeling who impersonated Riker and reconcile.

beats.title: Imzadi
beats.note: Facing the Borg, Riker tells Deanna he loves her and will see her soon.

threads.title: Seven of Nine & Raffi
threads.summary: Former Borg drone turned Fenris Ranger and a disgraced intelligence officer met aboard La Sirena in 2399 and fell together on Coppelius. Q's detour through an alternate 2401 and 2024 Los Angeles tested them and ended in a kiss, but the romance lapsed; in 2401–2402 they became a command team instead.
threads.status: Former lovers; since 2402 Captain Seven and her first officer Raffi command the Enterprise-G.

beats.title: Elnor falls
beats.note: Arriving in 2024, Raffi stays with the dying Elnor while Seven helps Rios keep the ship alive.

beats.title: Careless versus careful
beats.note: Hunting for Rios, they clash over risk; Seven sees that Raffi's anger is really grief for Elnor and her son Gabe.

beats.title: Growing old together
beats.note: Raffi calls them 'the main event' and pictures them old on a park bench, tripping teenagers with their canes.

beats.title: Back to back
beats.note: They fight Soong's mercenaries through La Sirena and hold the Jurati-Queen at gunpoint.

beats.title: Seven beams aboard La Sirena
beats.note: A wounded Seven arrives on Rios's ship, where Raffi is riding along to Freecloud.

beats.title: The Freecloud job
beats.note: Raffi and Seven work the same rescue mission on Freecloud as Seven settles her score with Bjayzl.

beats.title: Hands held on Coppelius
beats.note: After the synth crisis they reunite on La Sirena and quietly take each other's hand, beginning their romance.

beats.title: Strained by distance
beats.note: Seven's Fenris Ranger work keeps her from Raffi; Q then drops them into the Confederation of Earth.

beats.title: Stranded in an alternate 2401
beats.note: In Q's Confederation timeline they fight to rejoin Picard and escape with a captive Borg Queen.

beats.title: The kiss
beats.note: Back in 2401, Seven cuts off Raffi's worried speech with a kiss and tells her to 'let it breathe'.

beats.title: Former lovers
beats.note: Aboard the Titan-A, Raffi greets Seven, now her ex, and they work together against the Changelings.

beats.title: Staying behind
beats.note: When the Titan's young crew is assimilated, Seven and Raffi both choose to stay and retake the ship.

beats.title: Captain and first officer
beats.note: After retaking the Titan's bridge side by side, they take command of the renamed Enterprise-G a year later, Seven as captain and Raffi as her first officer.

threads.title: Picard & Q
threads.summary: Q put humanity on trial through Picard at Farpoint and spent the next six years testing, tormenting and occasionally helping him, ending with a trial that spanned three eras. Returning, dying, in 2401, Q used the Confederation timeline and 2024 Los Angeles as a last lesson and a gift before letting Picard go.
threads.status: Q says goodbye in 2024/2401 and is supposed to be dead, yet in 2402 he appears to Jack Crusher; the trial passes to the next generation.

beats.title: Q is dying
beats.note: In 2024, Guinan senses that Q's powers are failing and tells Picard that Q is dying.

beats.title: Farewell
beats.note: Q reveals the test was a gift to free Picard from his past, dies in Picard's presence and returns the crew home, reviving Elnor as a last surprise.

beats.title: Humanity on trial
beats.note: Q halts the Enterprise-D and puts humanity in the dock, with Picard as its defendant.

beats.title: Tempting Riker
beats.note: Q offers Riker the power of the Q, and Picard's faith in humanity wins the round.

beats.title: Meeting the Borg
beats.note: Q flings the Enterprise to System J-25 to show them the Borg; Picard admits he needs Q to get home.

beats.title: Q stripped of power
beats.note: Expelled from the Continuum and mortal, Q seeks refuge with Picard, then earns back his powers with an unselfish act.

beats.title: Robin Hood
beats.note: Q casts Picard's crew as the Merry Men to 'repay a debt', using Vash as bait.

beats.title: Amanda Rogers
beats.note: Picard challenges Q's intent to judge the young Q Amanda Rogers.

beats.title: A second chance at 2327
beats.note: After Picard's artificial heart fails, Q lets him relive his youth; Picard learns that the brash ensign made the captain.

beats.title: The trial never ends
beats.note: Q sends Picard across 2364, 2370 and an alternate 2395 to solve the anti-time anomaly, then says the trial never ends.

beats.title: Q's return
beats.note: Thirty years later Q reappears, older, and moves Picard into the Confederation of Earth.

beats.title: The road not taken
beats.note: Q shows Picard the tyrannical Confederation and makes him find the 2024 turning point that created it.

beats.title: The next generation
beats.note: A year after his apparent death Q appears to Picard's son Jack aboard the Enterprise-G: Jack's trial has just begun.

threads.title: Kirk & Spock
threads.summary: They met at a party aboard Pike's Enterprise in 2259, when Kirk was a Farragut lieutenant, and became the Federation's most storied command partnership. Their friendship was forged in SNW-era crises, deepened over Kirk's five-year mission, broken by Spock's death and restored on Vulcan. It outlived Kirk: an aged Spock carried it into the 24th century and, thrown into another reality, passed it on to a young alternate Kirk.
threads.status: Kirk vanished into the Nexus in 2293 and died on Veridian III in 2371; Spock outlived him, was thrown into the alternate reality in 2387, and died there (reported in that reality's 2263).

beats.source: The City on the Edge of Forever (episode)
beats.title: Together into 1930
beats.note: Kirk and Spock follow a delirious McCoy through the Guardian of Forever to 1930 New York. Spock works out that Edith Keeler must die, and stands with Kirk as he lets history take her.

beats.title: An old friend meets young Kirk
beats.note: Stranded on Delta Vega after following Nero back from 2387, the elderly Spock rescues the alternate reality's young Kirk, melds with him to explain Nero's attack, and steers him toward command. It is a different Kirk, but Spock greets him as his oldest friend.

beats.title: First meeting at a party
beats.note: After the Bannon's Nebula mission, Uhura introduces Lieutenant Kirk of the Farragut to Spock at a celebration aboard the Enterprise, the first time the two meet.

beats.source: The Sehlat Who Ate Its Tail (episode)
beats.title: Spock steadies an acting captain
beats.note: With Captain V'Rel wounded, Kirk commands the crippled Farragut with Spock, Uhura, Chapel and Scott as his crew; when he loses his nerve, Spock's counsel puts him back in the chair.

beats.title: A mind meld, and 'Jim'
beats.note: To fire the Farragut and Enterprise in perfect sync, Spock melds with Kirk and, at Kirk's request, starts calling him 'Jim'. Over chess afterwards they agree to stay friends and hope to serve on the same ship one day.

beats.title: Wanting a human best friend
beats.note: Intoxicated on Cesnar, Spock mistakes a vacationing Kirk for a hallucination, confides everything and concludes he wants a 'human best friend'. Kirk slaps him to prove he is real, helps save Ortegas and Scott, and promises to keep Spock's secrets.

beats.title: Spock Prime's death
beats.note: In the alternate reality, the young Spock learns that his elder self has died and finds among his effects a photograph of the prime Enterprise crew, Kirk among them.

beats.title: Captain Kirk, Commander Spock
beats.note: A displaced Uhura finds Kirk in command of the Enterprise a year ahead, with Spock as his first officer: the partnership to come. That 2263 belongs to a timeline that is later reset.

beats.source: Where No Man Has Gone Before (episode)
beats.title: Captain and first officer
beats.note: Now Kirk's first officer, Spock trades chess barbs with him and, as Gary Mitchell's powers grow, presses for the hard call; Kirk comes to rely on Spock's logic as the counterweight to his instincts.

beats.title: Mutiny for Pike
beats.note: Spock hijacks the Enterprise to carry the crippled Pike to Talos IV, risking execution. Kirk must sit in judgment of him, and in the end backs his friend's loyalty to his old captain.

beats.title: 'Jim!'
beats.note: Kirk defies orders to get Spock to Vulcan for his pon farr and is forced into ritual combat with him. Believing he has killed his captain, Spock breaks into open joy on finding Kirk alive.

beats.title: A history without Spock
beats.note: Back from a Guardian of Forever survey, Kirk alone remembers Spock in a timeline where he died as a boy and an Andorian is first officer; Spock goes into Vulcan's past to put things right.

beats.title: This simple feeling
beats.note: Back from the Kolinahr and cold at first, Spock is shaken by his meld with V'Ger and finally takes Kirk's hand, recognizing what simple friendship is worth.

beats.source: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
beats.title: Always shall be your friend
beats.note: Spock saves the Enterprise from the Genesis wave by restoring the warp drive in a flooded radiation chamber, and dies behind the glass after telling Kirk he has always been his friend.

beats.source: Star Trek III: The Search for Spock
beats.title: Stealing a ship for a friend
beats.note: Kirk defies Starfleet, steals and then destroys the Enterprise, and loses his son to recover Spock. After the fal-tor-pan the first person Spock recognizes is Kirk: 'Your name is Jim.'

beats.source: Star Trek IV: The Voyage Home
beats.title: Relearning the friendship
beats.note: On the trip to 1986 to fetch humpback whales, Kirk coaches the recovering Spock back into their old rapport; afterwards Spock tells Sarek that his shipmates are his friends.

beats.source: Star Trek V: The Final Frontier
beats.title: Campfire at Yosemite
beats.note: Shore leave with McCoy at Yosemite ends in Sybok's hijacking; when it is over, Kirk calls Spock his brother and names his two friends his real family.

beats.source: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country
beats.title: 'Only Nixon could go to China'
beats.note: Spock volunteers a resentful Kirk to escort Chancellor Gorkon, forcing him to face his hatred of Klingons; together they expose the conspiracy at Khitomer on the Enterprise-A's last mission.

beats.title: Kirk lost to the Nexus
beats.note: At the Enterprise-B's launch Kirk is swept away by the Nexus ribbon and presumed dead; Spock is not aboard. Kirk resurfaces in 2371 only to die on Veridian III.

beats.title: Carrying Khitomer's weight
beats.note: Working underground on Romulus, Spock tells Picard that he still bears the responsibility for committing Kirk and his crew to the Khitomer peace mission.

threads.title: Spock & Chapel
threads.summary: Nurse Chapel was drawn to the Enterprise's half-Vulcan science officer from the day she came aboard in 2259. On Pike's ship it became a short, real relationship that ended when she chose Roger Korby's fellowship; a decade later, under Kirk, it survived as a longing Spock could not answer. By the 2270s they are colleagues on the refitted Enterprise.
threads.status: Never rekindled: Chapel became a doctor and later a commander at Starfleet Command, while Spock's path led to Vulcan diplomacy.

beats.title: An instant attraction
beats.note: Newly aboard through a civilian exchange, Chapel is drawn to Spock at once and flirts with him openly.

beats.title: Confidante in the T'Pring trouble
beats.note: On Starbase 1 leave, Chapel helps Spock and T'Pring cope after a botched soul-sharing swaps their minds, and becomes his sounding board.

beats.title: A kiss staged for pirates
beats.note: Held hostage by Captain Angel, Spock and Chapel fake a love affair to derail a scheme to free Sybok. The kiss is an act, and part of the act is Spock pretending to break with T'Pring.

beats.title: Comfort after Hemmer
beats.note: Grieving Hemmer, Spock is swamped by rage and pain; Chapel follows him despite his wishes and holds him.

beats.title: Finally together
beats.note: Chapel's work restores the Vulcan half the Kerkhovians stripped from Spock. Once his engagement to T'Pring is over, the two admit their feelings and begin a relationship.

beats.title: A slip from the future
beats.note: Time-displaced Ensign Boimler lets slip that the future Spock shows no emotion, planting Chapel's doubt that their romance can last.

beats.title: The fellowship and the breakup
beats.note: Chapel is accepted into Roger Korby's fellowship and, in the crew's singing crisis, admits she is ready to leave Spock behind. Their relationship ends.

beats.title: Reunited under the Gorn
beats.note: Surviving the Cayuga's destruction, Chapel fights beside Spock and they crash the saucer into a Gorn tower together; afterwards she tells him their romance is over.

beats.title: Trelane's forced wedding
beats.note: Spock learns to dance for her return, only to find Chapel arriving with Korby. When Trelane rewrites reality so they wake up engaged, Spock breaks the spell and works with Korby to undo it.

beats.title: Reaching her katra
beats.note: Turned Vulcan for a mission and unwilling to change back, Chapel is reached by Spock through her katra and takes the cure, then apologizes to both Spock and Korby over dinner.

beats.title: House calls
beats.note: Too shaken after the Griffin to set foot in sickbay, Spock lets Chapel treat him in his quarters, and she shares her own wartime trauma from Yrti.

beats.title: A confession under infection
beats.note: Years later, the Psi 2000 intoxication pulls a confession of love out of Nurse Chapel, and Spock is stunned.

beats.title: Plomeek soup
beats.note: In the grip of pon farr Spock hurls away the soup Chapel made him; later, seeing she has been crying, he gently asks her for more.

beats.title: A hand held in sickbay
beats.note: While Spock lies in a Vulcan healing trance after being shot on Neural, Chapel holds his hand, and lets go quickly when Dr. M'Benga walks in.

beats.title: Carrying his mind
beats.note: While Henoch holds Spock's body, Sargon secretly places Spock's consciousness inside Chapel; she carries it until Henoch is defeated and Spock is restored.

beats.title: A forced kiss
beats.note: The telekinetic Platonians force Spock and Chapel into a kiss neither wants; she says the humiliation makes her want to crawl away.

beats.title: Mudd's love potion
beats.note: Chapel reluctantly tries Harry Mudd's love crystals on Spock. He briefly falls for her, then notes that minutes of love paid for with hours of hatred are no bargain.

beats.title: A cold homecoming
beats.note: Now Dr. Chapel, she comes to the bridge to welcome Spock back from Vulcan and gets only a cold look from a man still bound to the Kolinahr.

threads.title: Pike & Batel
threads.summary: Captains Pike and Batel kept their relationship casual until duty set them against each other, with Batel arresting and prosecuting Pike's first officer. The Gorn changed everything: Batel survived an implanted infection only through hybrid gene treatments, and that transformation let her become the Beholder, the eternal warden of the Vezda. Pike was left with the memory of a whole shared life that never happened.
threads.status: Batel stands forever as the Beholder on Vadia IX (2261); Pike is still grieving in 2262, when he finally mourns Juliet, the daughter they had only in the vision.

beats.title: Breakfast in Montana
beats.note: On leave at Pike's Bear Creek cabin, Batel presses him about whatever is keeping him from returning to command, just before Admiral April recalls him to the Enterprise.

beats.title: Orders to arrest Una
beats.note: Batel shares a meal with Pike aboard the Enterprise near the Neutral Zone outposts, then carries out orders she dislikes: arresting his first officer for hiding her Illyrian heritage.

beats.title: Opposite sides of the court
beats.note: Batel reluctantly prosecutes Una at her court-martial and tries to win her a plea deal; Una refuses it and is acquitted.

beats.title: A promotion lost, amends made
beats.note: Passed over for commodore in apparent retaliation for losing the case, Batel is at odds with Pike until he makes amends.

beats.title: A quarrel in song
beats.note: When a quantum field forces the crew to sing, Batel and Pike air a fight over a planned vacation in a duet, then patch things up over dinner in his quarters.

beats.title: Infected by the Gorn
beats.note: The Gorn destroy the Cayuga at Parnassus Beta. Pike's search party finds Batel alive but implanted with Gorn eggs, and she asks to be killed if there is no cure.

beats.title: Saved by Una's blood
beats.note: Allergic to stasis, Batel is saved by a treatment Spock and Chapel build around Una's Illyrian plasma; Pike visits as her long recovery begins.

beats.title: A dance at the Centennial
beats.note: Recovering aboard the Enterprise, Batel dances with Pike at the Federation Day Centennial once Trelane's meddling is undone.

beats.title: The infection returns
beats.note: When the Gorn infection flares again, Batel accepts an experimental chimera-blossom gene treatment without telling Pike its full nature, and he takes the Enterprise into forbidden space to get the flowers.

beats.title: A stranger behind her eyes
beats.note: A Gorn species memory surfaces: Batel attacks the Vezda-possessed Gamble and briefly fails to recognize Pike until sedation brings her back.

beats.title: Blunt Vulcan honesty
beats.note: A temporarily Vulcan Pike undercuts Batel's bid to return to Starfleet's judicial service. He apologizes once human again, and her own bluntness wins her the offer to head the department.

beats.title: She becomes the Beholder
beats.note: Her Gorn, Illyrian and chimera-altered body makes Batel the Beholder. Trapped by the Vezda, she and Pike live out a whole vision-life, marriage and a daughter named Juliet, before she seals the Vezda away as their eternal guardian.

beats.title: Six months without her
beats.note: Half a year later, Pike is still driving himself and his crew nonstop so he won't have to think about Batel.

beats.title: Mourning Juliet
beats.note: Caught in Trelane's soap-opera experiment, Pike finally lets himself grieve Juliet, the daughter he raised with Batel only in the vision, and goes back to counseling.

threads.title: La'an & Kirk
threads.summary: La'an's feelings for Kirk began with a different man: an alternate-timeline Captain Kirk she fell for, kissed and lost in 2022 Toronto while repairing history. The prime Kirk, a Farragut lieutenant, turned out to be taken, and their road since has run through a confession, a stabbing under alien madness and an arrest before a long-promised drink let them start over.
threads.status: They agree to start over in 2262; in the altered 2263 of 'Tomorrow's Enterprise' La'an is no longer aboard, and Captain Kirk will not say why.

beats.title: Falling for another Kirk
beats.note: Caught in an altered 2259 and thrown back to 2022 Toronto, La'an works beside that timeline's Captain Kirk, kisses him, and loses him to a Romulan agent before restoring history. This is the alternate-timeline Kirk (MA folds him into the 'James T. Kirk' article), not the prime one.

beats.title: A call to the real Kirk
beats.note: Back in her own timeline, La'an invents a pretext to call Lieutenant Kirk of the Farragut and breaks down after the call; he offers her a drink if they ever share a starbase.

beats.title: Face to face
beats.note: La'an meets the prime Kirk in person during the Bannon's Nebula mission and sees him go out of his way to help a struggling Uhura.

beats.title: The confession
beats.note: Shadowing Una aboard the Enterprise, Kirk reminds La'an she owes him a drink. When the singing field pushes her to tell him about his other self, he admits the connection but reveals that Carol Marcus is pregnant with his child.

beats.title: Landing party at Parnassus Beta
beats.note: Kirk and La'an go down together with the landing party searching the Gorn-ravaged colony for survivors.

beats.title: A Vulcan punch
beats.note: Turned Vulcan and bent on arming the Enterprise for war, La'an floors Kirk with one punch; she later apologizes, and Una tells her to hit Kirk only when he deserves it.

beats.title: A knife on the Griffin
beats.note: Driven mad aboard the derelict Griffin, La'an stabs Kirk and is about to kill him when the Enterprise beams them out; horrified, she thinks she deserves harsher judgment than Pike gives her.

beats.title: Arrest and escape
beats.note: Kirk comes aboard to talk about the Griffin just as Admiral Reeger takes over the ship. La'an arrests Kirk on Reeger's orders, he stuns her and escapes, and in the end she stuns the rogue admiral herself.

beats.title: The long-promised drink
beats.note: At peace with herself after a fairy-tale ordeal, La'an finally has that drink with Kirk, tells him what her necklace means, and they agree to start over with a dance.

beats.title: An unanswered question
beats.note: In an altered 2263, Captain Kirk turns visibly sad and deflects when a displaced Uhura asks where La'an is, a hint of what lies ahead.

threads.title: Burnham & Book
threads.summary: A 23rd-century officer who leapt 930 years ahead, and the 32nd-century courier she literally crashed into on arrival. Their partnership became a romance during the Federation's rebuilding, broke when Book sided with Ruon Tarka against the Dark Matter Anomaly, and was repaired on the hunt for the Progenitors' technology. The finale's epilogue shows them married decades later, with a son.
threads.status: Married; decades later they share a homestead on Sanctuary Four and their son Leto has just made captain (33rd century).

beats.title: Crash landing on Hima
beats.note: Burnham's Red Angel suit spits her out of the wormhole directly into the path of Book's ship. The wary courier becomes her guide to a galaxy without a working Federation, and they escape the Mercantile together.

beats.title: A year as couriers
beats.note: Discovery emerges a full year after her, and Burnham spends that year running courier jobs, often alongside Book, learning the new century from him.

beats.title: Unauthorized rescue on Hunhau
beats.note: When the Emerald Chain captures Book, Burnham takes his ship without orders to free him from a salvage-yard labor camp. The rescue costs her the first officer's post.

beats.title: Home to Kwejian
beats.note: Book goes back to Kwejian to face the Emerald Chain's grip on his homeworld. Burnham meets his estranged brother Kyheem and his nephew Leto.

beats.title: Retaking Discovery together
beats.note: Osyraa tortures Book with a neural lock to pressure Burnham. Once the ship is retaken, his Kwejian empathy lets him navigate the spore drive, and Burnham takes command of Discovery.

beats.title: Kwejian destroyed
beats.note: The Dark Matter Anomaly tears Kwejian apart, killing Kyheem and Leto. Book's grief, and Burnham's attempts to reach him through it, shape the whole year.

beats.title: Saying it out loud
beats.note: With Discovery trapped in a subspace rift, Book says a private farewell to his lost family, and he and Burnham tell each other they love one another before he beams to safety.

beats.title: The vote that splits them
beats.note: The Federation assembly chooses first contact over destroying the anomaly. Book leaves with Ruon Tarka and the prototype spore drive to do it themselves, which puts him on the opposite side from Burnham.

beats.title: Standoff at the anomaly
beats.note: Burnham leads the pursuit of Book's cloaked ship with orders to use lethal force if needed. In the confrontation neither of them can bring themselves to destroy the other.

beats.title: Choosing Earth over Tarka
beats.note: Book turns on Tarka to protect Discovery and Earth, and he survives only because Species 10-C pull him out as his ship is destroyed. He accepts a sentence of relief work for families displaced by the anomaly.

beats.title: Partners again, warily
beats.note: After months of not speaking, the two are paired on the classified Progenitors mission and fall back into their old courier banter.

beats.title: Kwejian's World Root saved
beats.note: At the Eternal Gallery and Archive, Book receives two surviving cuttings of Kwejian's World Root, a way to replant the living symbol of his people somewhere new.

beats.title: "I never stopped"
beats.note: At Saru and T'Rina's wedding, Burnham tells Book she never stopped loving him; they kiss and head off on Kovich's next assignment together. He has planted the World Root on Sanctuary Four, the planet of their first adventure.

beats.title: Admiral Burnham, husband Book
beats.note: Decades on, a grey-haired Admiral Burnham wakes beside Book at their Sanctuary Four homestead. Their son Leto, newly made captain, flies her to Discovery's final mission. The year is not given; this placement is an estimate.

threads.title: Stamets & Culber
threads.summary: Discovery's spore-drive engineer and its doctor, a couple from the ship's first months at war in 2256. Culber's murder in the mirror universe seemed to end them, until Stamets found him alive inside the mycelial network and he was rebuilt in a new body. They rode Discovery into 3189 and formed a family there with Adira Tal and Gray.
threads.status: Married and serving together aboard Discovery as of 3191; they do not appear in the series' epilogue.

beats.title: Two toothbrushes, one worry
beats.note: Their first scene as a couple: brushing their teeth in shared quarters, with Culber worried about what the spore drive is doing to Stamets. Dialogue here says they first met in a café.

beats.title: A kiss before the last jump
beats.note: Culber objects to the toll of 133 spore jumps. Stamets kisses him before what is meant to be his final jump, which goes wrong and strands Discovery in the mirror universe.

beats.title: Culber is murdered
beats.note: While Stamets lies comatose, Culber's examination exposes the surgically altered Tyler, and the surfacing Voq kills him by breaking his neck.

beats.title: Goodbye in the network
beats.note: Trapped inside the mycelial network, Stamets meets Culber's consciousness, which pushes him to save the network and go back to the living.

beats.title: Brought back to life
beats.note: Searching the network for Tilly, Stamets finds that Culber still exists there. The jahSepp rebuild his body from a cocoon and he walks out alive.

beats.title: Home, but not himself
beats.note: Culber's memories are intact but his rebuilt body feels foreign, and seeing Tyler, his killer, in the corridors makes it worse.

beats.title: Culber moves out
beats.note: Culber leaves their quarters to find his footing. Spock suggests to a hurt Stamets that the distance is about Culber's sense of self, not his feelings.

beats.title: "You are my home"
beats.note: Culber had planned a transfer to the Enterprise but stays. With Stamets badly wounded in the battle against Control, he tells him he is his home as Discovery leaps into the future.

beats.title: Back under one roof
beats.note: In the 32nd century they move back in together, and Stamets confides how much Adira has come to mean to him.

beats.title: A family on the line
beats.note: While Culber and Adira are stuck in the radiation-soaked Verubin Nebula, Stamets frets over both and calls Adira his child. The family they have built with Adira and Gray is now said out loud.

beats.title: Comparing notes at home
beats.note: In their quarters they trade accounts of the day: refugees resettled for Culber, the arrogant Ruon Tarka for Stamets. A snapshot of a settled married life.

beats.title: The counselor cracks
beats.note: Stamets finds Culber stress-cleaning their quarters. The doctor who has been counseling everyone blames himself for not reaching Book, and Stamets tries to lift that weight.

beats.title: Hosting Jinaal Bix
beats.note: Culber volunteers to carry the consciousness of Trill scientist Jinaal Bix through zhian'tara. The experience sets off a spiritual awakening he cannot explain scientifically.

beats.title: Mofongo and a brain scan
beats.note: Culber tries to recreate his grandmother's mofongo for his husband and asks Stamets for a full neural scan to study the after-effects of zhian'tara; Stamets is uneasy but helps.

beats.title: "I'll come back"
beats.note: Following an instinct he cannot explain, Culber insists on joining Book's dangerous portal mission. Stamets lets him go, and Culber keeps his promise to return.

threads.title: Worf & Jadzia Dax
threads.summary: Worf's transfer to Deep Space 9 in 2372 put him opposite Jadzia Dax, whose appetite for Klingon culture and relentless teasing wore down his reserve. After a courtship fought partly with bat'leths they married in 2374, only for Jadzia to be murdered months later; Worf then risked his life in battle to win her a place in Sto-Vo-Kor.
threads.status: Ended by Jadzia's death (2374); Worf and the symbiont's next host, Ezri, settle into friendship in 2375.

beats.title: Sparks in the holosuite
beats.note: Worf arrives on the station amid the Klingon crisis. Jadzia is visibly taken with him and challenges him to bat'leth practice.

beats.title: Questing with Kor
beats.note: Jadzia brings Worf together with her old friend Kor, and the three hunt for the legendary Sword of Kahless.

beats.source: Looking for par'Mach in All the Wrong Places (episode)
beats.title: A bat'leth courtship
beats.note: Tired of Worf missing her hints, Jadzia starts a holosuite fight that becomes a Klingon mating ritual; they become a couple.

beats.source: Let He Who Is Without Sin... (episode)
beats.title: Trouble on Risa
beats.note: A vacation on Risa turns tense when Worf falls in with the New Essentialists, forcing the two to confront how differently they approach love.

beats.title: Aboard the Rotarran
beats.note: Jadzia serves with Worf on Martok's battered bird-of-prey; the mission ends with Martok taking Worf into his House.

beats.title: Marry me after the war
beats.note: As the Federation abandons the station to the Dominion, Jadzia says goodbye to Worf and agrees to marry him once the war ends.

beats.title: A Klingon wedding
beats.note: After surviving the hostility of Martok's wife Sirella, Jadzia marries Worf and joins the House of Martok.

beats.title: Love over duty
beats.note: Worf aborts a vital intelligence extraction to carry the badly wounded Jadzia to safety; Sisko warns it has cost him a command of his own.

beats.title: Jadzia is killed
beats.note: Dukat, possessed by a Pah-wraith, strikes Jadzia down in the station's temple. The Dax symbiont survives and is rushed to Trill.

beats.title: A place in Sto-Vo-Kor
beats.note: Worf learns that dying outside battle bars Jadzia from Sto-Vo-Kor, and resolves to win a great victory in her name.

beats.title: Battle in her name
beats.note: Worf, Martok, O'Brien, Bashir and Quark destroy the Dominion's Monac shipyard, dedicating the victory to Jadzia.

beats.title: Meeting Ezri
beats.note: The Dax symbiont returns to the station in a new host, Ezri; Worf walks out of Quark's rather than face her.

beats.title: Stranded with Ezri
beats.note: Ezri finds Worf after his ship is lost; old feelings resurface and they spend a night together before the Breen capture them.

beats.title: Letting Jadzia go
beats.note: Facing execution as Dominion prisoners, Worf and Ezri admit their attraction was an echo of Jadzia and agree to be friends.

threads.title: Odo & Kira
threads.summary: Odo and Kira met on Cardassian-run Terok Nor in 2365 and after 2369 became the station's most trusted partnership, while Odo hid his love for her for years. Tested by the Founders, a time paradox and the Dominion occupation, they finally became a couple in 2374, until Odo left to heal the Great Link.
threads.status: Parted in 2375 when Odo joined the Great Link; Kira stayed to command Deep Space 9.

beats.title: First meeting on Terok Nor
beats.note: During the Occupation, Odo questions young resistance fighter Kira about the murder of the collaborator Vaatrik, and accepts her alibi.

beats.title: The Vaatrik lie uncovered
beats.note: Reopening the old case, Odo learns Kira was Vaatrik's killer and had lied to him; the friendship survives the shock.

beats.title: A confession to the wrong Kira
beats.note: Odo tells a trapped 'Kira' that he loves her, only to realize she is the Female Changeling testing his ties to the solids.

beats.title: Jealousy over Shakaar
beats.note: Assigned to protect First Minister Shakaar as Kira falls for him, Odo hides his heartbreak and wrecks his own quarters.

beats.title: The Terok Nor executions
beats.note: Odo admits that as the Cardassians' security chief he let three innocent Bajorans be executed, shaking Kira's faith in him.

beats.title: The future Odo's secret
beats.note: An elder Odo from a timeline where the crew was stranded in 2173 reveals his love to Kira and sabotages their escape to save her, erasing his colony.

beats.title: Left behind with the enemy
beats.note: Both remain aboard when the Dominion occupies the station, Kira as Bajor's liaison and Odo keeping order.

beats.title: Odo chooses the Link
beats.note: Odo links with the Female Changeling and fails Kira's resistance cell at a critical moment; she feels betrayed.

beats.title: Odo saves Kira
beats.note: Learning Kira is to be executed, Odo breaks from the Female Changeling and frees her, helping the Federation retake the station.

beats.title: Finally together
beats.note: Coached by the holographic Vic Fontaine, Odo stops hiding his feelings and he and Kira kiss, beginning their relationship.

beats.title: Loved as he is
beats.note: When Odo is tempted to leave with the Changeling Laas, Kira tells him she loves the man he has chosen to be.

beats.title: A hidden illness
beats.note: Bashir finds Odo carries the disease killing the Founders; Odo heads to Cardassia with Kira and Garak without telling her.

beats.title: Kira sees the sickness
beats.note: In the Cardassian underground Kira discovers how badly Odo's disease has advanced.

beats.title: Farewell at the Great Link
beats.note: With the war over, Odo goes home to cure the Founders and teach them; Kira takes him to the Great Link for a last goodbye.

threads.title: Paris & Torres
threads.summary: A disgraced pilot out of a penal colony and a half-Klingon Maquis engineer start out needling each other aboard a ship stranded 70,000 light-years from home. Seven years of shared crises turn the sparring into devotion: she admits her love while both float toward death in EV suits, they marry during a starship race, and their daughter arrives as Voyager crosses into the Alpha Quadrant.
threads.status: Married since 2377, daughter Miral born 2378; both stayed in Starfleet after Voyager's return.

beats.title: Stranded on the same ship
beats.note: Paris, a cashiered pilot let out of a penal colony to guide Voyager, and Torres, the hot-tempered engineer of Chakotay's Maquis cell, both end up aboard after the Caretaker hurls them into the Delta Quadrant.

beats.title: Prisoners of the Vidiians
beats.note: Vidiian scientists split Torres into separate Klingon and Human women; Paris, held with her in a labor camp, looks out for the frightened Human half.

beats.title: Pon farr on an away mission
beats.note: Caught up in Vorik's pon farr, Torres bites Paris to begin a Klingon mating ritual; he refuses to take advantage of her even when she pleads with him.

beats.title: Confession in EV suits
beats.note: Drifting in space suits with their air running out after the Caatati take their shuttle's warp core, Torres tells Paris she loves him; Voyager reaches them in time.

beats.title: The first kiss
beats.note: When Torres tries to take the confession back and suggests they forget it, Paris cuts her off with a kiss.

beats.title: Watched, and reprimanded
beats.note: Hidden Srivani researchers are scanning the new couple as part of their experiments on the crew, and Janeway gives both a stern dressing-down after they are caught getting too close on duty.

beats.title: Restless pilot, broken dates
beats.note: Paris keeps canceling dates to tinker with an alien test pilot's ship, and Torres storms off; he makes peace with a kiss in his Grease Monkey garage program.

beats.title: She shuts him out
beats.note: Numb after learning the Maquis were wiped out, Torres pushes Paris away and secretly runs holodeck programs with the safeties off until Chakotay confronts her.

beats.title: Their duplicates marry first
beats.note: Biomimetic copies of the crew, who believe they are the real Voyager, stage a Paris and Torres wedding before their ship dissolves; the real couple never learns of it.

beats.title: A proposal mid-race, then marriage
beats.note: During an interstellar rally in the Delta Flyer, Paris asks Torres to marry him; they wed and fly off on a honeymoon with 'Just Married' painted on the stern.

beats.title: A daughter on the way
beats.note: Pregnant with a girl, Torres secretly tries to edit the baby's Klingon traits out of her genome, fearing her own childhood pain; Paris objects and they reconcile.

beats.title: The prophesied kuvah'magh
beats.note: A generational ship of Klingons hails Torres's unborn child as their promised savior, and Paris accepts a warrior's challenge to defend her honor.

beats.title: Strangers again on Quarra
beats.note: Memory-wiped and put to work on Quarra, Paris the bartender flirts with Torres as if meeting her for the first time; once restored, she reads his logs and sees how much he loves her.

beats.title: A call home together
